tables.name: tracker_metadata
rows: video (multi-view support from expert knowledge only)
photometric (differentiable mesh rasterization) + adaptive regional appearance priors + landmarks
FLAME 2023 (required, with vertex masks); FLAME 2020 supported
FLAME files licence-gated; repo licence not verified
monocular RGB (extended to multi-view in arXiv 2608.04722)
tables.notes: Offline/optimisation nature of Metrical Tracker and VHAP is corroborated by two sources (2608.04722, 2608.09238) = verified; other cells single-source. null = not stated. Expert-knowledge additions (not sourced): Metrical Tracker uses MediaPipe dense + 68-pt landmarks and SH photometric term; VHAP originates from GaussianAvatars and handles NeRSemble 16-camera data; video-head-tracker is from Neural Head Avatars (CVPR 2022).

tables.name: multiview_setups
rows: Multi-View Face and Gesture Animation with Dynamic Gaussians (2026)
single FLAME fit; identity from MICA
tables.notes: Joint single-parameter-set fitting is verified as a principle (both 2026 papers). Rows 3-4 are expert knowledge without URLs. No row has a quantified accuracy gain (null).

tables.name: perspective_magnification_vs_distance
tables.units: distance m; magnification ratio (dimensionless); 35mm-equivalent focal mm
tables.population: Adult head; assumed nose-tip-to-tragus depth 0.10 m (plausible range 0.09-0.12 m); framing ~0.45 m on the 36 mm long side
tables.notes: Derived: magnification = 1 + depth/d; lens = 36 mm * d / 0.45 m. Heuristic: focal length is weakly observable from a face alone when d/depth > ~12 (d > ~1.2 m); then lock focal to EXIF.

tables.name: metric_scale_cues
rows: scale error floor of prior-only fits
tables.notes: Anthropometric means/SDs from expert knowledge; verify before using as default priors. Object dimensions are standard sizes.

tables.name: suggested_fitting_priors
tables.population: Starting values for a FLAME-style multi-view landmark fitter; tune via leave-one-view-out error
tables.notes: Engine defaults read from face3d/solve/bundle.py and face3d/solve/pnp.py in this repo. Suggested values are expert heuristics, not sourced.

tables.name: flame_model_constants
rows: articulated joints (neck, jaw, left eye, right eye) + global rotation, axis-angle params each
tables.notes: Read the actual model file at load time rather than hard-coding; engine works in mm (x1000).
